user_input: how does tiktok recommend content so precisely
model_output:
TikTok uses a combination of human curators and algorithms to recommend content to its users.

Human curators: TikTok employs a team of people who manually select and curate popular and trending videos to feature on the platform's homepage and in its recommended videos section. These curators have a deep understanding of TikTok's audience and what types of content are likely to be successful.

Algorithms: TikTok also uses algorithms to recommend content to its users based on their viewing history, engagement with certain content, and other factors. These algorithms are designed to identify the types of content that an individual user is likely to enjoy and recommend similar content to them.

By combining human judgment and algorithmic recommendations, TikTok is able to provide a personalized and relevant experience for its users, which can help to keep them engaged and coming back for more.
